# #382 frozen smoke protocol fixture

### Manual Smoke Test Protocol

> Every block runs from the worktree root. Blocks that invoke the `codeloop` CLI create their
> sandbox under `$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-382/...`, the only root the state guard recognises.
> Block 1 rebuilds the `dist/` every later block requires.

**Smoke 1 — build the branch’s own CLI**

```bash
set -eu
npm run build
node -e 'const { DiffAnalyzer } = require("./dist/domain"); if (typeof DiffAnalyzer.analyzeDiff !== "function") { console.error("FAIL: dist/domain is stale"); process.exit(1); } console.log("PASS: dist/ rebuilt from this worktree");'
```

**Smoke 2 — D1 classifies diff lines before matching**

```bash
set -eu
node - <<'NODE'
const assert = require('node:assert');
const { DiffAnalyzer } = require('./dist/domain');
const TOKEN = 'BREAKING CHANGE:';

const headers = [
  'diff --git a/docs/x.md b/docs/x.md',
  '--- a/docs/x.md',
  '+++ b/docs/x.md'
];

const contextOnly = [...headers, '@@ -1,3 +1,4 @@', ' ' + TOKEN + ' silent commits are forbidden.', ' unchanged', '+new line', ' context', ''].join('\n');
const hunkOnly = [...headers, '@@ -1 +1 @@ ' + TOKEN + ' trailer', ' unchanged', ''].join('\n');
const headerOnly = ['diff --git a/x.md b/BREAKING CHANGE: notes.md', '--- a/x.md', '+++ b/BREAKING CHANGE: notes.md', '@@ -1 +1 @@', '+plain', ''].join('\n');
const metaOnly = [...headers, '@@ -1 +1 @@', 'Binary files a/x and b/BREAKING CHANGE: y differ', ''].join('\n');
const added = [...headers, '@@ -1 +1,2 @@', ' context', '+' + TOKEN + ' description', ''].join('\n');
const removed = [...headers, '@@ -1,2 +1 @@', '-' + TOKEN + ' description', ' context', ''].join('\n');
const bareFooter = [...headers, '@@ -1 +1,2 @@', ' context', '+BREAKING CHANGE:', ''].join('\n');

const negatives = [['context-only', contextOnly], ['hunk-header-only', hunkOnly], ['file-header-path-only', headerOnly], ['meta-only', metaOnly]];
const positives = [['added-line', added], ['removed-line', removed], ['bare-footer', bareFooter]];

for (const [label, diff] of negatives) {
  const plan = DiffAnalyzer.analyzeDiff(diff, { issueNumber: 1, issueTitle: 'x' });
  assert.strictEqual(plan.isBreaking, false, label + ' must not be breaking');
  assert.ok(!plan.commitMessage.toSingleLine().includes('!'), label + ' subject must not carry !');
  console.log('not breaking:', label, '->', plan.commitMessage.toSingleLine());
}
for (const [label, diff] of positives) {
  const plan = DiffAnalyzer.analyzeDiff(diff, { issueNumber: 1, issueTitle: 'x' });
  assert.strictEqual(plan.isBreaking, true, label + ' must be breaking');
  assert.ok(plan.commitMessage.toSingleLine().includes('!:'), label + ' subject must carry !');
  console.log('breaking   :', label, '->', plan.commitMessage.toSingleLine());
}
const metrics = DiffAnalyzer.calculateMetrics(contextOnly);
assert.deepStrictEqual(metrics, { additions: 1, deletions: 0 }, JSON.stringify(metrics));
console.log('PASS: context, hunk header, file header and meta lines no longer declare a breaking change');
NODE
```

**Smoke 3 — D2 whole-bullet sentinel, both directions**

```bash
set -eu
node - <<'NODE'
const assert = require('node:assert');
const { ReviewVerdict } = require('./dist/domain');
const { applyTwoTierInvariant } = require('./dist/application');

const verdictFor = (bullet) => ReviewVerdict.parse(
  'REVIEW_STATUS: APPROVED\nREVIEW_SUMMARY: ok\nUNFULFILLED_AC:\n- ' + bullet + '\nREMEDIATION_GUIDANCE:\n- None.'
);

const sentinels = ['None', 'None.', 'None required', 'None (deferred to post-commit)', 'None in the reviewed scope', 'None in the reviewed in-repo scope (deferred to post-commit).', 'n/a', 'N/A', 'nil'];
const criteria = ['none of the retries are bounded', 'None of the new rules are tested', 'Test path: none of the retries are bounded'];

for (const bullet of sentinels) {
  const verdict = verdictFor(bullet);
  assert.deepStrictEqual([...verdict.unfulfilledCriteria], [], 'sentinel: ' + bullet);
  assert.strictEqual(applyTwoTierInvariant(verdict, null).verdict.status, 'APPROVED', 'sentinel: ' + bullet);
  console.log('no criteria :', bullet);
}
for (const bullet of criteria) {
  const verdict = verdictFor(bullet);
  assert.deepStrictEqual([...verdict.unfulfilledCriteria], [bullet], 'criterion: ' + bullet);
  assert.strictEqual(applyTwoTierInvariant(verdict, null).verdict.status, 'CHANGES_REQUESTED', 'criterion: ' + bullet);
  console.log('escalated   :', bullet);
}

const remediation = ReviewVerdict.parse('REVIEW_STATUS: CHANGES_REQUESTED\nREVIEW_SUMMARY: fix it\nUNFULFILLED_AC:\n- None\nREMEDIATION_GUIDANCE:\n- None of the patches applied cleanly');
assert.deepStrictEqual([...remediation.remediationGuidance], ['None of the patches applied cleanly']);
console.log('PASS: none of ... is a criterion; the marker shapes are still empty');
NODE
```

**Smoke 4 — D3 the option-taking wrapper table**

```bash
set -eu
node - <<'NODE'
const assert = require('node:assert');
const { isCommittedTreeAssertion, parseQualityGateTargets, lintQualityGateTargets, MSG_GATE_TARGET_UNEXECUTABLE_ENTRY } = require('./dist/domain');

const refused = [
  "bash -c 'git diff --exit-code'",
  "bash -o pipefail -c 'git diff --exit-code'",
  "bash +o pipefail -c 'git diff --exit-code'",
  "bash -O extglob -c 'git diff --exit-code'",
  "bash --rcfile /tmp/rc -c 'git diff --exit-code'",
  "sh -o errexit -c 'git diff --exit-code'",
  "bash +O -c 'git diff --exit-code'",
  "fish --command 'git diff --exit-code'"
];
const allowed = [
  "bash -o pipefail -c 'npm test'",
  "bash -o pipefail -c 'git diff --stat'",
  "bash -o pipefail -c 'git status --porcelain'",
  'bash script.sh'
];

for (const command of refused) assert.strictEqual(isCommittedTreeAssertion(command), true, command);
for (const command of allowed) assert.strictEqual(isCommittedTreeAssertion(command), false, command);
console.log('classification: ' + refused.length + ' refused, ' + allowed.length + ' allowed');

const fence = String.fromCharCode(96, 96, 96);
const plan = ['### Quality Gate Targets', fence + 'bash', ...refused, ...allowed, fence].join('\n');
const parsed = parseQualityGateTargets(plan);
assert.deepStrictEqual(parsed.rejections, [], JSON.stringify(parsed.rejections));
assert.deepStrictEqual(lintQualityGateTargets(parsed.targets).map((f) => f.command), refused);
console.log('lint findings: ' + refused.length + ', rejections: 0');

assert.ok(MSG_GATE_TARGET_UNEXECUTABLE_ENTRY.includes('chains are split'), 'the message must say && chains are split');
assert.ok(!MSG_GATE_TARGET_UNEXECUTABLE_ENTRY.includes('split compound commands'), 'the message must not ask for && splitting');
console.log('PASS: option-taking wrappers are refused by the same rule; no over-refusal');
NODE
```

**Smoke 5 — D4 title rule, precedence and lockstep**

```bash
set -eu
node - <<'NODE'
const assert = require('node:assert');
const { detectIssueKind } = require('./dist/domain');
const { FilePlanGenerator } = require('./dist/infrastructure');

const falsePositives = ['Improve error handling', 'Feature: RCA tooling', 'Add a bug reporting dashboard', 'Error budget dashboard for SLOs', 'Add defect tracking view', 'Reduce regression test flakiness'];
const markers = ['[Bug] x', 'Bug: x', 'fix: x', 'fixing the loop', 'RCA: x', 'regression/a', 'crash on login', '[error] x'];
const generator = new FilePlanGenerator();

for (const title of falsePositives) {
  assert.deepStrictEqual(detectIssueKind({ title }), { kind: 'feature', source: 'none' }, title);
  assert.strictEqual(generator.detectPlanType({ title, labels: [] }), 'implementation', title);
  console.log('feature:', title);
}
for (const title of markers) {
  assert.deepStrictEqual(detectIssueKind({ title }), { kind: 'bug', source: 'title' }, title);
  assert.strictEqual(generator.detectPlanType({ title, labels: [] }), 'discovery', title);
  console.log('bug    :', title);
}

assert.deepStrictEqual(detectIssueKind({ labels: ['enhancement'], title: 'Improve error handling' }), { kind: 'feature', source: 'label' });
assert.deepStrictEqual(detectIssueKind({ labels: ['enhancement'], title: '[Bug] x' }), { kind: 'bug', source: 'title' });
assert.deepStrictEqual(detectIssueKind({ labels: ['bug'], title: 'Add dark mode' }), { kind: 'bug', source: 'label' });
assert.strictEqual(detectIssueKind({ title: 'Add dark mode', labelsUnavailable: true }).labelsUnavailable, true);
assert.strictEqual('labelsUnavailable' in detectIssueKind({ title: 'Add dark mode' }), false);
console.log('PASS: marker titles stay bugs, ordinary English is a feature, labels win for non-markers');
NODE
```

**Smoke 6 — a CLI approval refuses an option-taking wrapper, then accepts a real test target**

```bash
set -eu
WT="$PWD"
SANDBOX="$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-382/approval-refusal"
rm -rf "$SANDBOX"
mkdir -p "$SANDBOX/artifacts/plans/382-probe"
cd "$SANDBOX"
git init -q -b main
git config user.email smoke@example.test
git config user.name smoke
printf 'seed\n' > README.md
git add -A
git commit -qm 'chore: seed'
cat > artifacts/plans/382-probe/implementation_plan.md <<'PLAN'
# [Implementation] - approval probe

## 3. Implementation Steps
- [ ] **Step 1:** hold the line

### Quality Gate Targets

- `bash -o pipefail -c 'git diff --exit-code'`
PLAN
node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),path=require("path");const now=new Date().toISOString();fs.writeFileSync(".agyloop/tasks/382.json",JSON.stringify({version:"1.0.0",currentStage:"PLAN",mode:"standard",issue:382,baseBranch:"main",planDir:path.resolve("artifacts/plans/382-probe"),createdAt:now,updatedAt:now,history:[{stage:"DISCOVERY",timestamp:now},{stage:"PLAN",timestamp:now}],pausedAtGate:null,pausedAtTimestamp:null,totalHumanWaitMs:0},null,2))'
set +e
OUT="$(env -u AGY_SUBAGENT node "$WT/bin/codeloop.js" transition APPROVAL --issue 382 2>&1)"
CODE=$?
set -e
printf '%s\n' "$OUT"
[ "$CODE" -ne 0 ] || { echo 'FAIL: the wrapper must not be approved'; exit 1; }
printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | grep -q "bash -o pipefail -c 'git diff --exit-code'"
printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | grep -q 'can never pass'
node -e 'const p=JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(".agyloop/tasks/382.json","utf8"));if(p.currentStage!=="PLAN")throw new Error("checkpoint moved to "+p.currentStage);console.log("checkpoint still PLAN")'
cat > artifacts/plans/382-probe/implementation_plan.md <<'PLAN'
# [Implementation] - approval probe

## 3. Implementation Steps
- [ ] **Step 1:** hold the line

### Quality Gate Targets

- `bash -o pipefail -c 'npm test'`
PLAN
env -u AGY_SUBAGENT node "$WT/bin/codeloop.js" transition APPROVAL --issue 382
node -e 'const p=JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(".agyloop/tasks/382.json","utf8"));if(p.currentStage!=="APPROVAL")throw new Error("expected APPROVAL, got "+p.currentStage);console.log("checkpoint now APPROVAL")'
printf 'PASS: an option-taking wrapper is refused; a real test target is accepted\n'
```

**Smoke 7 — the commit warning follows the FINAL message, not the plan flag**

```bash
set -eu
WT="$PWD"
SANDBOX="$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-382/commit-warning"
rm -rf "$SANDBOX"
mkdir -p "$SANDBOX/artifacts/plans/382-probe"
cd "$SANDBOX"
git init -q -b main
git config user.email smoke@example.test
git config user.name smoke
printf 'seed\n' > README.md
git add -A
git commit -qm 'chore: seed'
printf 'seed\nBREAKING CHANGE: probe footer\n' > README.md
printf '# [Implementation] - commit probe\n' > artifacts/plans/382-probe/implementation_plan.md
node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),path=require("path");const now=new Date().toISOString();fs.writeFileSync(".agyloop/tasks/382.json",JSON.stringify({version:"1.0.0",currentStage:"REVIEW",mode:"standard",issue:382,baseBranch:"main",planDir:path.resolve("artifacts/plans/382-probe"),createdAt:now,updatedAt:now,history:[{stage:"REVIEW",timestamp:now}],worktree:{taskId:"382",worktreePath:path.resolve("."),branch:"task/382",baseBranch:"main",isIsolated:false},pausedAtGate:null,pausedAtTimestamp:null,totalHumanWaitMs:0},null,2))'

DEFAULT="$(env -u AGY_SUBAGENT node "$WT/bin/codeloop.js" commit --issue 382 -y --keep-worktree --dry-run 2>&1)"
printf '%s\n' "$DEFAULT" | grep -q 'BREAKING CHANGE detected'
printf 'without override: warning present\n'

printf 'docs: probe subject (#382)\n' > msg-safe.md
SAFE="$(env -u AGY_SUBAGENT node "$WT/bin/codeloop.js" commit --issue 382 -y --keep-worktree --dry-run --message-file "$SANDBOX/msg-safe.md" 2>&1)"
if printf '%s\n' "$SAFE" | grep -q 'BREAKING CHANGE detected'; then
  echo 'FAIL: a non-breaking override must silence the warning'; exit 1
fi
printf '%s\n' "$SAFE" | grep -q 'docs: probe subject (#382)'
printf 'with non-breaking override: no warning\n'

printf 'docs: probe subject (#382)\n\nBREAKING CHANGE: real footer\n' > msg-breaking.md
BREAKING="$(env -u AGY_SUBAGENT node "$WT/bin/codeloop.js" commit --issue 382 -y --keep-worktree --dry-run --message-file "$SANDBOX/msg-breaking.md" 2>&1)"
printf '%s\n' "$BREAKING" | grep -q 'BREAKING CHANGE detected'
printf 'with breaking override: warning present\n'
printf 'PASS: the warning reflects the final message\n'
```

**Smoke 8 — an unreadable label lookup never silently skips DISCOVERY**

```bash
set -eu
WT="$PWD"
SANDBOX="$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-382/labels-unavailable"
rm -rf "$SANDBOX"
mkdir -p "$SANDBOX/.bin"
cd "$SANDBOX"
git init -q -b main
git config user.email smoke@example.test
git config user.name smoke
printf 'seed\n' > README.md
git add -A
git commit -qm 'chore: seed'
printf '#!/bin/sh\necho "gh: not authenticated" >&2\nexit 1\n' > .bin/gh
chmod +x .bin/gh
export PATH="$SANDBOX/.bin:$PATH"

set +e
REFUSED="$(env -u AGY_SUBAGENT node "$WT/bin/codeloop.js" plan --issue 999 --dry-run 2>&1)"
CODE=$?
set -e
printf '%s\n' "$REFUSED"
[ "$CODE" -ne 0 ] || { echo 'FAIL: an unreadable lookup must not silently pick feature'; exit 1; }
printf '%s\n' "$REFUSED" | grep -q -- '--type discovery'
[ ! -d artifacts ] || { echo 'FAIL: a refused entry must scaffold nothing'; exit 1; }
[ ! -f .agyloop/tasks/999.json ] || { echo 'FAIL: a refused entry must write no checkpoint'; exit 1; }
printf 'first run, no --type: refused with a clear message\n'

env -u AGY_SUBAGENT node "$WT/bin/codeloop.js" plan --issue 999 --title 'Dashboard filters' 2>&1 | grep -q 'labels could not be read'
node -e 'const p=JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(".agyloop/tasks/999.json","utf8"));if(!p.history.some((h)=>h.metadata&&h.metadata.labelsUnavailable===true))throw new Error("labelsUnavailable was not recorded");console.log("labelsUnavailable recorded on the checkpoint")'
printf 'PASS: unreadable labels are explicit, refused without --type and recorded when proceeding\n'
```
